description: One section of law with full text and its place in the code (GET /v1/statutes/sections/{section_id}, or by citation via GET /v1/statutes/lookup). Give section_id from a search or a bill/measure link, or state + citation exactly as the code prints it (e.g. '39:4-50', '790.01', '18-3-102'). Set include_bills:true to also return the bills that amend, create, repeal or cite the section. Only states whose code is loaded resolve to section text (see list_statute_coverage); a link to a section we hold carries resolved:true and the text, otherwise just the citation as written.

citation.description: Section citation without the code prefix, e.g. '39:4-50'.

code.description: code_key when a citation exists in more than one code of the state.

include_bills.description: Also fetch the bills that touch this section.

section_id.description: section_id from a statute search or link.

state.description: 2-letter postal code (e.g. NJ), DC, GU, or US for the U.S. Code.

name: get_statute
title: One statute section
